name: Natsuiro
source:
Friendship, love... one step a time, the distance between them grows smaller... 
In the dazzling light of the season, a summer colored love story. 
Their examination results, their friendship, their love... all of it is up to you to decide from many options. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE041333.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
友情、爱情……一步一步，距离越来越近…… 
在季节的耀眼光芒下，演绎出夏日色彩的爱情故事。
他们的考试成绩、他们的友情、他们的爱情……一切都由你从众多选择中做出选择。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE041333.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
